privacy: Screenshots and AX captures contain private session content. Keep local. Do not publish or include session bodies in test fixtures.
observed: Existing independent login survived the rebuild.
Connected to the existing MacMini Host and passively opened the same completed conversation as the official reference.
Opened settings, right pane, and trajectory. No real prompts, approvals, cancellation, settings mutations, or terminal creation were performed.
Exited this candidate with Cmd+Q; CUA application inventory confirmed it was no longer running.

findings.detail: Long content paints through the header and pushes the composer beyond the window bottom. Child flex height constraints need correction; clipping alone is insufficient.
After selecting the comparison conversation, other workspaces keep their headings but lose their session rows. Full Host catalog must remain independent from the active workspace.
Settings rail is vertically centered; scrolling content exceeds the modal boundary and hides its header/close button.
Right pane starts below the top of the content area. Files control remains disabled because capabilities are not yet integrated.
Body and sidebar appear heavier than the official reference. Recheck system font weight after the font selection fix.
Raw event list does not match the official request/context/tool rows, timeline overview, filters and search. Data availability is not UI parity.
Model/permission/commands/feedback/fork and other visible operations still await capability wiring. Compatibility plugin page is not in this candidate.

freeze.method: qa/verify-freeze.mjs plus clean git status of both frozen source references

acceptanceBoundary: Go/fixture checks and developer M4 measurements do not establish visual or M1 performance acceptance. Report fixes only after rebuilding and observing them in the actual app.
